assumption_ledger.note: Exact magnitude of schema drift is unknown until RN-101 audit completes; plan assumes drift exists based on legacy shim masking behavior

dependency_notes.reason: Schema audit must precede fixture updates; fixtures need to reflect the actual drift discovered in the audit
Dashboard summary consumes step-id schema and must not ship until fixtures reflect the new schema
Runbook requires known rollout/rollback shape which only becomes available after dashboard is proven in canary

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Documented schema drift report with concrete step-id changes
ordered_steps.summary: Identify schema drift in the translator before removing the legacy parser shim. This reveals the actual step-id schema that downstream components depend on.
ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures that pass tests/plan_contract.py with new step ids
ordered_steps.summary: Update fixtures to reflect the new schema so the plan contract test catches ordering regressions.
ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary enabled in canary with kill switch for rollback
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema stability is confirmed.
ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch

ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook with validated rollout/rollback procedures
ordered_steps.summary: Document rollout and rollback procedures once the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist

mitigations: Complete RN-101 schema audit before any dashboard work
Update fixtures in RN-102 to catch ordering regressions in tests
Enable dashboard behind kill switch (RN-103) for safe rollback
primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect step ordering to users if schema drift is not audited before enabling the summary
